    else: print('ok',name)

H=8; kinds='KKKDZQTK'   # per = (8-4-1)*N = 3N
tmpl=bytes.fromhex('aa'*H)
def hdr(kinds, q=3, ttl=9, Kbad=False, d=0x77, z=0xee):
    h=bytearray(tmpl)
    for i,c in enumerate(kinds):
        if c=='D': h[i]=d
        if c=='Z': h[i]=z
    h[kinds.index('Q')]=q; h[kinds.index('T')]=ttl
    if Kbad: h[0]^=0xff
    return bytes(h).hex()
def fl(fid,path):
    return dict(id=fid,path=path,template=tmpl.hex(),kinds=kinds)
